Please verify the download media types listed in the structured metadata for the authoritative detail record of each dataset. If there are at least 3 different types, label it as "Ready for interactive embedding"; if there are 1–2 types, label it as "Download only"; if no downloadable media types are listed, label it as "Needs review". The answer must include a table with only the two columns `entity_name` and `label`, followed by the statistical counts for the three categories after the table.
